name: blocksweep
title: blocksweep
blurb: paste a Bluesky list link, pick members or subscribers, sign in, and bulk-block everyone on it with one confirm — real app.bsky.graph.block records, not a subscribe. @moll.dev wondered aloud about blocking all the subscribers of a blocklist that's being used against people; the AppView has no index of who's subscribed to a list, so this originally swept only the list's curated membership. @aly.codes pointed out constellation.microcosm.blue independently indexes every app.bsky.graph.listblock record by its target list, which is exactly the subscriber list — so now it does both.
